description: Export a curated GitHub source tree. Keep current core regression tests and exclude historical release-only tests, duplicate fixtures and maintenance-only tools. Local authoring tests are not deleted. Release notes and bilingual commit summaries belong beside ZIP/MSI, never in source exports.

important_coverage: installer launch, upgrade, folder picker and completion rendering
v1.1.0 scoped UI state, selected profile snapshots, solid menus and close progress
test_policy.review_rule: Add new tests only for active important behavior; remove superseded fixtures together with their runner scripts after dependency and regression verification.

release_changes.commit_title: Improve restore workflows, glass readability and confirmation dialogs
release_changes.commit_title_zh: 优化恢复流程、毛玻璃列表可读性与确认弹窗

changes.change: Advance the application identity to v1.1.1.
changes.change_zh: 将应用版本标识升级为 v1.1.1。

changes.change: Publish the v1.1.1 installer identity while retaining same-version reinstall and upgrade behavior.
changes.change_zh: 发布 v1.1.1 安装程序标识，并保留同版本重新安装与覆盖升级行为。

changes.change: Include the active v1.1.1 verification suite in curated source exports.
changes.change_zh: 将 v1.1.1 当前回归测试纳入精简源码导出。

changes.change: Add selection pinning, live parallel restore progress, a delayed process refresh, shared profile process selection, readable glass list surfaces, solid confirmation dialogs, and corrected about-page actions.
changes.change_zh: 新增所选程序置顶、并行恢复进度、延迟刷新进程、配置共用程序选择器、提升毛玻璃列表可读性、确认弹窗纯色隔离及关于页按钮对齐。

changes.change: Add v1.1.1 regression coverage for profile selection, sorting, localization, restore progress, delayed refresh, glass readability and solid confirmation dialogs.
changes.change_zh: 新增 v1.1.1 回归覆盖，验证配置选择、排序置顶、多语言、恢复进度、延迟刷新、毛玻璃可读性与纯色确认弹窗。
